## Changes

- Recover expired login sessions centrally and retain the return destination; distinguish unavailable menus and denied page access.
- Restore task-tray interaction above drawers, show VPS choices before searching, and align shared checkbox/autocomplete styling.
- Probe VLESS Reality camouflage domains from the selected VPS, with compatibility results and direct selection.
- Forward complete generic HTTP request context to admitted plugin route owners, including raw query, headers, request target and peer metadata, while retaining host route admission and body limits.
- Allow protocol listen addresses to be configured, including IPv6, while preserving existing IPv4 defaults.
- Support local uploads and external URLs for site Logo, dark Logo, favicon and ticket attachments. Ticket downloads enforce current permissions; referenced files cannot be deleted.

## Upgrade notes

- Includes append-only database migrations 0030 and 0031.
- Persist the file directory configured by `ZBOARD_FILE_STORAGE_DIR` (default `/var/lib/zboard/files`) together with database backups. Docker configurations include the shared persistent mount.
- Site images allow 2 MiB per file; ticket attachments allow 5 MiB per file and five attachments per message.
- This is a development prerelease.
